bundle.shortDescription: Tell it what's going on; it keeps your work in order.
bundle.longDescription: Suk keeps track of the people you work with, your projects, tasks, ideas and notes. Tell it what's going on in plain words; it organizes everything into pages, plans your day and follows the people whose work you care about. Built with academics in mind. It runs on your computer, keeps your notes as Markdown files, and works through Claude Code or Codex.
